failures.reason: Extra Lisp closing parenthesis in the parameter-body refactoring; reader refused it.
Special required parameter in an inlined literal lambda leaked its binding record. Added the missing extent around binding and body, after operand evaluation; inline-parameter-extent reproduces it.
PROGV guard initially assumed a flat call-argument IR. Retained U1 IR is ((one-form) NIL); the exact compiler-inserted shape is now required.
Test expected no allocation for dp_escaped. It creates an escaping closure; its explicit expectation is now 24 bytes. Same correction made for pv_escape.

Forty binding recursion levels at the default 64-word result budget exhaust the 32 KiB fixture stack. The positive recursion test now requests its needed four-word result budget; the production resource check is unchanged.
Test expected a captured self cell/environment for dp_labels. Self recursion uses SELF and captures nothing; expected allocation corrected from 40 to 24 bytes.

Exploratory keyword-read-dynamic mutant changed to b-read-variable, which still reads the same private slot for uncaptured specials; it was semantically inert and passed. Not counted as a rejection. Replaced with an actual read through the current dynamic binding, which is the risk the control is meant to exercise.

inherited_regressions: The normalizer, token-overlap and package-identity regressions are inherited from accepted earlier packets; they are not new discoveries.
native: R6/R6a qualifies the final compiler; the accepted pristine baseline is reused.
